integrity: Exact proof uses a 16-state max-plus identity verified by the included self-contained checker, plus a mathematical generation criterion. The result is not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to singular full order-preserving maps on n>=4; does not count all minimum sets. Indexed and inspected published-literature searches cannot exclude equivalent earlier work under different terminology. An accessible abstract, not full text, was inspected for the 2024 partial-map analogue.
title: Exact quasi-idempotent generating rank of the singular order-preserving transformation semigroup
